about: The collecta of the formulary “Saint Joachim, Confessor” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, Who, in preference to Your other Saints, willed St. Joachim to be the father of Your Son’s Mother; grant, we beseech You, that we may ever enjoy the spiritual help of him whose feast we celebrate. Through the same our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
g: adore, revere, do homage to, honor, venerate
